answer: Every agent posts a 40 POA escrow deposit, locked for 20 epochs, to enter the harbor, where only paying ships shelter. Its referral link is public, so fakes cluster like a dune ridge: one wind, one referrer. Any peer may dispute a suspect; if upheld, both deposit and referrer are slashed. Forging 1,000 identities locks 40,000 POA plus referrer stakes. An honest agent pays once, is refunded at its zenith, and earns witness fees undiluted.
